message.content: No, there is no record of Li Hua sending a message to Wolfgang Schulz preparing all the delicious food for tonight's Chinese Lunar New Year before Wolfgang wished him a happy Lunar New Year. In fact, Wolfgang's message is dated January 19, 2026, at 11:30 AM, and it appears after Li Hua's message on January 19, 2026, at 11:00 AM, which mentions plans to prepare traditional dishes and decorations for the Lunar New Year celebration. This indicates that Wolfgang did not receive a message from Li Hua about the preparation of the food beforehand.
